focused_command: $env:VULGATA_TEST_POSTGRES_ADMIN='<approved disposable admin connection>'; dotnet test tests/Vulgata.Tests/Vulgata.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~Pass1ProductionCompositionTests|FullyQualifiedName~PreparedPass1WorkerDispatcherTests|FullyQualifiedName~Pass1ClaimedPacketExecutionTests|FullyQualifiedName~Pass1DurableNavigationRecoveryTests|FullyQualifiedName~Pass1ProductionBoundaryQualificationTests" --no-restore --logger "console;verbosity=normal"

implementation.durable_hydration: Claim hydration reloads the persisted navigation high-water, state version, accepted-call count, and evidence bytes; remaining capacity is exactly 8 - ToolAttemptCount.
implementation.dispatcher: PreparedPass1WorkerDispatcher owns no conversation, retry, provider-turn, callback-slot, or budget state and invokes the executor exactly once per durable claim.
implementation.marker_repair: PreparedPass1JobRunner requires the typed marker-repair port before hydration/provider and before retry or terminal visibility. PreparedPass1Store re-reads current durable state and idempotently creates Calls receipt ordinal nine only at high-water eight under current lease/version/authorization.
implementation.composition: Production DI maps reservation and marker-repair ports to the same scoped PreparedPass1Store; missing marker composition now fails closed.
implementation.restart: Retry, lease recovery, process restart, and sibling claims reconstruct capacity only from PostgreSQL and cannot reset or share the budget.

review_corrections: Three legacy dispatcher tests were updated from the removed outer retry loop to the accepted single-dispatch executor-owned conversation.
The production-boundary inspection now recognizes the reservation dependency and durable eight-attempt owner.
A follow-up RED proved optional marker-store resolution could bypass repair; production now uses GetRequiredService and the isolated fixture registers an explicit marker test double.
database: PostgreSQL coverage used fixture-managed disposable databases through the approved admin connection. The ordinary vulgata database was not targeted.
privacy: No provider request, source-bearing traffic, credential output, host setting, system configuration, service, firewall, or global tool state was accessed or changed.
warnings: Existing NU1507 and EF assembly-version warnings remain; the focused suite succeeded.
